We are looking for motivated employees who want to work as an order picker at Action in Zwaagdijk. 
Are you interested? Read on quick! 
As an order picker at Action you have a diverse function. You ensure that the right goods are ready for shipment in time and fully so that they can be brought to the branches by the drivers. You do this by collecting the articles that are passed on through the voicepick system. You will stack, pack, seal, label, sort and prepare the roll containers and place them on the correct dock. The voicepick system is available in Dutch, English or Polish. 
You work an average of 38 hours per week. There are two shifts: the first starts at 06:00 and the second starts at 15:00. End times are flexible. On Saturdays there is only a morning shift. On your first day you start at 14:00 PM. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as an order picker. 
 Job Requirements 
 - At least 18 years old - You speak Polish, Slovak, Czech or good English - Hands-on and accurate - Team player - You want to work for a longer period of time 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation - Organized transport to work - Weekly payments
